verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes an llms.txt documentation index, confirmed live by an HTTP 200 probe that identifies it as the canonical entry point. Docs pages also link to markdown versions, and the quickstart includes a prompt to paste into a coding agent. The probe 404 hit a malformed `/.md` path, not the documented `llm_observability.md` form, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs in practice, and no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
